6969.title: File preview drops the visualization palette
6969.rootCauseOneLine: Inline HTML is themed srcdoc; expansion forwards only a file target, so the sidebar loads raw HTML without the inline theme document.
6969.proposedFix: Preserve visualization rendering intent through expansion and share frame-document behavior across inline and sidebar surfaces; leave generic HTML raw.
6969.caveats: Component-boundary reproduction with real plugin click and sidebar renderer; fixture RPC/raw-file transport supplied by harness. No full-app, desktop, or iOS run. Reproduction code and output are embedded in the HTML under reports policy; no raw artifacts are committed.
